from statistics import median
img=Image.open('/app/figure.jpg').convert('RGB')

        r,g,b=img.getpixel((x,y))
        # purple trace: saturated violet, not black/gray
        if r>120 and b>150 and b>g+25 and r>g+20:
            py.append(y)

        if r<70 and g<70 and b<70:
            by.append(y)

def runs(data):

            start=x; vals=[]; counts=[]

    return out
for name,data in [('black',black),('purple',purple)]:
    print('\n',name)
    for r in runs(data):
        if r[1]-r[0]>5:
            print(r)
